verified.bloom_gates: G2 only, and weakly. G2 is met in the narrow sense of a concrete, company-committed, dated deliverable: all three adult OPUS trials fully enrolled with 6,191 adults dosed and Q4-2026 topline reaffirmed 2026-08-05. G1 fails outright — no named counterparty, no partner, no deal. G3 fails — I could not identify any specific currently-unpriced figure; adult VAX-31 approval and a peak-sales ramp are already inside the ~$111 consensus target and inside a $8.63B market cap for a company with zero revenue and $2.51B cash.
verified.edge: L — run-up +100% from the 52wk low of $29.87 to $59.79 (and ~+13% over the $52.95 200dma base that spans the whole period since guidance was first given in Feb 2026); remaining capture only +8.7% to the $65 52wk high, and the +86% to the ~$111 consensus target is an inherited analyst DCF that underwrites infant success and a peak-sales ramp, NOT the OPUS-1 event — I decline to carry it as the favorable-resolution value. Mostly-harvested plus a noninferiority design (adult Phase 2 already read out positive, so the market prior on success is high) means the payoff is skewed the wrong way: modest re-rate on a beat, severe de-rate on a miss.

verified.analysis: The catalyst is real, dated, forward and unfired — OPUS-1 topline is company-guided to Q4 2026, reaffirmed at Q2 on 2026-08-05, with enrollment complete (6,191 adults) so the date is no longer at risk from recruitment. But the design is the problem: OPUS-1 is a pivotal NONINFERIORITY trial against Capvaxive and Prevnar 20 in adults, and VAX-31's adult Phase 2 immunogenicity already read out strongly, so the market's prior on success is high and adult approval is largely embedded in an $8.63B cap for a pre-revenue company. The genuinely unpriced binary at Vaxcyte is the infant program (the franchise-defining, previously-disappointing dataset), and that does not read out until end-1H27 — outside this milestone. On residual capture the name is mostly harvested: doubled off the 52wk low, sitting 8% under the 52wk high, 20+ analysts covering. Gap in verification: the SEC 8-K exhibit and two IR pages 403'd/timed out, so cash ($2,507.7M at 6/30/26), net loss ($284.3M) and enrollment figures come from the syndicated Q2 release rather than a direct primary read; and I could not price the option chain to confirm the implied move.
